script: [serious] At 2:45 p.m. on July 30th, 1975, the former boss of America's most powerful union stood in a restaurant parking lot outside Detroit. Then Jimmy Hoffa vanished. He had come to meet two men tied to the Mafia. Neither, they later said, ever showed up. No body. No witnesses. Only a borrowed car, where police dogs picked up his scent. The FBI's own memo concluded he was murdered on the orders of organized crime. Fifty-one years of digging, under a horse farm, under a landfill, have found nothing. Send this to someone who thinks nobody can just disappear. This is Dossier Decoded. Case file number thirteen. A new file every day.
